notes:
1.1.1
The themes panel is two columns: every look on the left, the controls that make one on the right.
Seven new factory sounds — 999 in the library.
A modulation can push from where the knob sits instead of swinging around it: the new from knob toggle on each LFO.
The A/B bar is easier to read, and a modulation ring is never thicker than the slider it sits on.
The space bar reaches your DAW's transport again on macOS.
The manual names the right files.
